name: batch_spin_35k

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 18 * * *'  # 01:00 VN (UTC+7)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      workers:
        description: 'Số luồng (mặc định: 32)'
        required: false
        default: '32'
        type: string
      limit:
        description: 'Giới hạn số acc (0 = hết)'
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: string
      fresh:
        description: 'Chạy lại từ đầu (xóa done file)'
        required: false
        default: '1'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: batch-spin-35k
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  spin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 350

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install websocket-client -q --break-system-packages

      - name: Clear done file for new day
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.fresh != '0' }}
        run: |
          echo "Clearing acc_spin_done.txt for fresh run..."
          rm -f acc_spin_done.txt spin_report.csv acc_alive.txt acc_dead.txt
          echo "Cleared."

      - name: Run batch spin 35k accounts
        env:
          WORKERS: ${{ inputs.workers || '32' }}
          LIMIT: ${{ inputs.limit || '0' }}
        run: |
          echo "=== $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') Starting batch spin ==="
          echo "Workers: $WORKERS | Limit: $LIMIT"
          echo "Accounts: $(wc -l < acc_valid_all.txt)"
          echo "Already done: $(wc -l < acc_spin_done.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
          echo "---"
          python3 check_spin_batch.py acc_valid_all.txt $WORKERS $LIMIT

      - name: Upload results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: spin-results
          path: |
            acc_alive.txt
            acc_dead.txt
            acc_spin_done.txt
            spin_report.csv
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Batch Spin 35k — Tổng kết" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Accounts: $(wc -l < acc_valid_all.txt)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Processed: $(wc -l < acc_spin_done.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Alive: $(wc -l < acc_alive.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ -f spin_report.csv ]; then
            echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "### Stats" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            awk -F, 'NR>1{s+=$4+$5; r+=$6; t+=$7; n++} END{
              if(n>0) {
                print "Acc processed:  " n
                print "Total spins:    " s
                print "Total reward:    " r " xu"
                print "Transferred:     " t " xu"
                print "Avg reward/acc:  " int(r/n) " xu"
              }
            }' spin_report.csv >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi
